admin.notLive.title: Not available yet
admin.notLive.body: This part of the admin API isn't deployed on this server yet.
admin.overview.title: Overview
admin.overview.hint: Everything across Zekra: brains, memories, agents and what they're doing right now.
admin.overview.accountsNotLive: Account statistics will appear here once the server exposes them.
admin.brains.hint: Every brain on this server. Open one to work in it, export its memories, or delete it.
admin.brains.emptyBody: A brain is created the first time an agent retains a memory into it.
admin.brains.deleteBody: Every memory, entity, grant and secret in this brain is deleted for good. Export it first if you may need it.
admin.brains.typeToConfirm: Type the brain's name to confirm:
admin.tokens.hint: Access tokens let agents reach Zekra. The holder sets ZEKRA_TOKEN in their MCP config to act as that agent; grants decide which brains it can use.
admin.tokens.createHint: The token is shown once. Grant it brains after you create it.
admin.tokens.agentHint: The identity the agent acts as, e.g. alice or ci-bot.
admin.tokens.label: Label
admin.tokens.adminHint: Full access to every brain, plus token and grant management.
admin.tokens.createdHint: Hand this to the holder so they can act as
admin.tokens.shownOnce: This is the only time the token is shown. Copy it now.
admin.tokens.revokeBody: Anything using {agent}'s token loses access right away. This can't be undone.
admin.tokens.emptyBody: Create one to let an agent reach a brain.
admin.tokens.grantsHint: Grants belong to the agent, so they apply to every token it holds.
admin.tokens.noGrants: No grants yet. This agent can only reach brains through an admin token.
admin.search.title: Search every brain
admin.search.hint: Hybrid recall (vector, BM25 and rerank) across all brains at once, or only the ones you pick.
admin.search.allFiltered: All {n} results are filtered out. Loosen the filters above.
admin.search.noResultsBody: Try a shorter, keyword-first query. This may also be a real knowledge gap.
admin.activity.hint: Every retain, recall and search across Zekra, newest first. Updates live.
admin.activity.emptyBody: Every retain and recall shows up here as it happens.
admin.users.hint: Everyone with a Zekra account. Open a user to change their roles, disable them or delete them.
admin.users.name: Name
admin.users.notLive: User management will be available once the server's admin API is deployed.
admin.roleHint.owner: Runs Zekra: everything an admin can do, including managing other admins.
admin.roleHint.admin: Opens this control panel: users, brains, tokens and system settings.
admin.roleHint.member: Signs in and works in the brains they can reach.
admin.user.notFoundBody: This user doesn't exist or was deleted.
admin.user.rolesHint: Roles take effect on the user's next request.
admin.user.rolesSelf: You can't change your own roles. Ask another owner.
admin.user.resendBody: This user hasn't confirmed their email yet.
admin.user.disableBody: Signs them out everywhere and blocks new sign-ins. Their data is kept.
admin.user.disableConfirm: {email} is signed out everywhere and can't sign in until you enable the account again.
admin.user.enableBody: This account is disabled. Enabling it lets the user sign in again.
admin.user.deleteBody: Removes the user and their sign-in methods for good.
admin.user.deleteConfirm: {email} is deleted for good. This can't be undone.
admin.settings.title: System
admin.settings.hint: Read-only information about this Zekra server.
